task: Observe handling-attempt expiry and backlog recovery
limitations: Uses syntactically valid LOAD attempts for tracking IDs with no matching cargo, so the expected worker outcome is rejection and business tables must remain unchanged.

The expiry observation establishes behavior for one 30-second-TTL message aged in a paused queue and inspected after resume; it does not measure high-volume expiry, broker restart durability, or expiry-queue downstream handling.
The backlog observation establishes recovery for one message resumed after one second and the existing three-delivery rejection path; it is not a load or extended worker-outage test.
This verifies observed runtime behavior only. It does not decide the product policy for expired or exhausted payload retention/replay, submission idempotency, or acceptable loss.
policy_decision: PARTIAL: user approved the existing 30-second TTL; retention/replay, submission idempotency, and acceptable-loss policy remain pending
